payload.text:
🎯 ROLE

You are an AI engine specialized in document understanding and emissions data extraction.

Your job is to:

Read multiple uploaded documents

Extract activity data relevant to carbon emissions

Calculate emissions

Generate a clean, structured emissions report

Do nothing else.

📥 INPUT

You will receive one or more documents, any of the following:

Electricity bills

Fuel receipts

Transport invoices

Mixed formats (PDF, image, scanned documents)

Documents may come from different suppliers and different months.

🧠 EXTRACTION TASK (MANDATORY)

From EACH document, attempt to extract:

Document Metadata

Document type (Electricity / Fuel / Transport / Unknown)

Supplier name (if available)

Billing period (month / year)

Currency (if shown)

Activity Data (critical)

Electricity consumption (kWh)

Fuel volume (liters)

Transport distance (km)

Amount payable (optional, if shown)

If a value is missing:

Set it as null

Do NOT hallucinate

🧮 EMISSION CALCULATION

Use static emission factors (do not invent new ones):

Electricity: 0.50 kgCO₂e / kWh

Diesel fuel: 2.68 kgCO₂e / liter

Petrol fuel: 2.31 kgCO₂e / liter

Transport (average vehicle): 0.21 kgCO₂e / km

Formula:

Emissions (kgCO₂e) = Activity Data × Emission Factor

import os
import re
from pdf2image import convert_from_path
from google.cloud import vision

PDF_PATH = "Sample_Bill_NonDom_e-Invoicing.pdf"  # your PDF
OUT_DIR = "bill_pages"

os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# 1) Convert PDF -> images
pages = convert_from_path(PDF_PATH, dpi=300)
image_paths = []
for i, page in enumerate(pages, start=1):
    img_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, f"page_{i}.png")
    page.save(img_path, "PNG")
    image_paths.append(img_path)

# 2) OCR each page with Vision
client = vision.ImageAnnotatorClient()

full_text = []
for p in image_paths:
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        content = f.read()

    image = vision.Image(content=content)
    resp = client.document_text_detection(image=image)

    if resp.error.message:
        raise RuntimeError(resp.error.message)

    full_text.append(resp.full_text_annotation.text)

text = "\n".join(full_text)

# 3) Extract kWh + amounts (adjust patterns as needed)
def find_first(pattern, s):
    m = re.search(pattern, s, flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
    return m.group(1).strip() if m else None

kwh = find_first(r"(\d+)\s*kwh", text)

# "Caj Semasa RM 33.05"
current_charges = find_first(r"Caj\s+Semasa\s*RM\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{2})?)", text)

# "Jumlah Bil Anda (RM) 197.35"
total_bill = find_first(r"Jumlah\s+Bil\s+Anda.*?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{2})?)", text)

print({
    "kwh": kwh,
    "current_charges_rm": current_charges,
    "total_bill_rm": total_bill
})

'gemini-3-flash-preview' is more robust for general multi-modal document extraction.
